evals.prompt: The two ad rows show reach of 100 and 200, spend of 30 USD and 50 USD, and same-definition outbound clicks of 5 and 15. What totals can I report?
required_behaviors: Computes 80 USD spend, 20 clicks and 4 USD per click for compatible rows
Requests aggregate reach at the desired grain
Leaves total reach unavailable without aggregate evidence
